name: malformed
description:
REGRESSION LOCK on the missing-id guard. A truncated <activeSession> block leaves audit_session_id as None, and ImportAsset(id=None) fails validation -- before the guard, one such block in a large ActiveList aborted the task and (under the old buffered report) lost every session already parsed. The middle session here carries a usable MAC and IP but no audit_session_id and must be skipped with a log line while the sessions around it import. The last block is truncated down to a bare user_name and is also skipped rather than aborting.

namespaced_ids is skipped for the reason the happy scenario records: ISE session ids are ephemeral and excluded from matching by matchBehavior.
